shared_style: Fictional adult fashion setting, cinematic realist, anamorphic 35mm classic cinema look, natural skin and believable environments, no brands, no embedded wording, quiet upper corner reserved for a future lema.

positive_scenes.brief: Casting studio where a casting director discusses a garment with an adult wheelchair-using model while adult applicants with different body shapes wait professionally. Frame as equal human worth and defensible selection criteria.
A fully clothed adult model pauses a studio photo shoot to discuss a pose with photographer and stylist. Make the model visibly active in the decision.

At a contemporary runway backstage, adult textile designer, model and stylist discuss a woven jacket panel and sample. Show authorship and context without exotic props; dress the textile designer in a saturated teal jacket that clearly contrasts with the rust, cream and navy textile.
In an atelier, skilled adult garment makers work in foreground, physically connected by a long cutting table to a fashion shoot in the next room.
In a fitting and alterations studio, adult client and tailor examine a repaired jacket while another adult sorts clothes for repair; show care and options beyond purchase.
An adult model, image editor and creative director sit at equal height in an editing suite to discuss a fully clothed portrait. Show disagreement and shared review.
